description: This file contains unit tests for the RemoteCacheBasedDeviceConnectionService class, verifying its behavior in setting and getting device gateway information using an Infinispan cache. It uses JUnit 5, Mockito, and Vert.x testing extensions.

classes.name: RemoteCacheBasedDeviceConnectionServiceTest
classes.description: A test class for RemoteCacheBasedDeviceConnectionService, verifying setting and retrieving device gateway info with mocked dependencies.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes mocks and the service instance before each test.

methods.name: givenAStartedService
methods.description: Mocks Vert.x context and starts the service asynchronously, returning a Future indicating readiness.

methods.name: testSetLastKnownGatewayForDevice
methods.description: Tests setting the last known gateway for a device and verifies cache interaction and response status.

methods.name: testGetLastKnownGatewayForDeviceNotFound
methods.description: Tests retrieving the last known gateway when no entry exists, expecting a 404 response.
